calculation.description: Fade each asset's volatility-normalized ten-day return residual to the contemporaneous cross-asset mean, with a bounded multiplier that increases during high cross-asset residual-dispersion regimes. All inputs are lagged historical observations at the signal date.

validation.regime_notes: Positive 10-day IC in all reported regimes: 0.057957 over 2026-07-16 to 2027-12-31 (375 dates), 0.015998 over 2028-01-01 to 2029-12-31 (521 dates), 0.061279 over 2030-01-01 to 2032-12-31 (784 dates), and 0.033729 over 2033-01-01 to 2035-01-07 (523 dates). Small 15-asset cross-section requires conservative uncertainty interpretation.
